draft.emotion: matter-of-fact and habitual, describing a routine state of being
notes: Do not confuse 'носить' (to wear habitually) with 'надеть' (the single action of putting clothes on).
For carrying, 'носить' is a multidirectional verb (carrying repeatedly or in multiple trips). For carrying something in one direction right now, use 'нести'.
